absorbed.general_pattern: A host consumer must rehash exactly the configuration-key population recorded by a container producer through the producer's receipt-bound guest-to-host mounts. Missing, changed, foreign, or additional files cannot be credited by partial comparison.
absorbed.before: Guest configuration paths were interpreted directly in the host namespace, so current producer bytes could not be revalidated correctly.
absorbed.after: The consumer maps and rehashes exactly the 40 producer-recorded configuration keys and requires complete dictionary equality. A valid empty mount list remains valid; newly visible image-only files outside the recorded keys do not expand the configuration population.
absorbed.claim_boundary: The 40-of-40 check re-read an existing producer receipt without rerunning synthesis; the later bound-handoff absence remained a separate failure in that measurement.

absorbed.general_pattern: When a container probe returns executable configuration text, launcher diagnostics and the payload must use separate channels. The caller accepts exactly one typed JSON payload, validates required commands, and preserves the payload bytes before appending source-owned declarations.
absorbed.before: Container startup diagnostics could be concatenated into generated Tcl and fail only when the downstream tool interpreted the contaminated file.
absorbed.after: The native Tcl is carried in one structured JSON envelope; missing, ambiguous, malformed, empty, or command-incomplete payloads refuse before the target file is published.
